description: This file defines the CategoryOptions entity for Android Room persistence, representing category-specific settings including account ID, category name, and optional sorting method.

classes.name: CategoryOptions
classes.description: Entity class representing options for categories, including account ID, category name, and optional sorting method, with database constraints.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with this category options.

methods.name: setAccountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID for this category options.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the name of the category.

methods.name: getSortingMethod
methods.description: Returns the sorting method for the category, if any.

methods.name: setSortingMethod
methods.description: Sets the sorting method for the category.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on accountId, category, and sortingMethod.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on accountId, category, and sortingMethod.
